Effects performance probe (Release, i7-3537U, 640x480): pre-cache 20-sample p50 ms source-only 7.788, Blur 71.603, Shadow 76.972, stack 88.612, 64 Blur objects 114.551; pre-cache isolated Blur 40-sample p50/p95 78.020/124.646 ms. Bounded cache stages up to 262144 output pixels (4 MiB) after complete preflight; larger regions retain the existing two-pass path. Post-cache compositor CTest passed 1/1 Release. Post-cache 20-sample Blur/Shadow/stack/64-object p50/p95 ms: 85.999/94.510, 71.759/87.278, 74.533/86.342, 89.902/101.815. Three pre-SIMD Blur 40-sample runs in the current session were 204.323/255.089, 204.783/266.125 and 208.355/279.261 ms; three SSE2 runs were 50.641/58.444, 50.517/57.856 and 53.867/66.547 ms with identical checksum 14946842818742444328. This is about 75% lower median p50 on one CPU, but p50 remains above 33.3 ms. AVX dispatch parity passed and was enabled on the same host; repeated Release p50/p95 were 52.690/67.021, 52.763/64.889 and 57.730/97.154 ms with the same checksum; median 52.763/67.021 is slightly slower than SSE2. The bounded two-lane trial and serial control used the same 640x480 Blur fixture, 40 samples and checksum: parallel p50/p95 runs 547.779/1931.361, 202.335/478.219, 147.802/244.515 ms; serial control 146.605/189.802, 202.757/1197.394, 183.516/331.486 ms. Median p50/p95 were 202.335/478.219 parallel and 183.516/331.486 serial; process CPU p50 medians were both 78.125 ms and host load was unstable, so no useful latency gain was demonstrated and the code was removed. Latest full Debug CTest after restoring the serial AVX/SSE2 baseline passed 80/80, including the prior desktop paste-bounds and COM catalog cases; the earlier 77/80 run is superseded. A new same-fixture Release 3x40 Blur baseline has median p50/p95 49.6/73.9 ms on i7-3537U with unchanged checksum; process peak-memory delta is not scratch-memory measurement; the performance gate remains open; see docs/reviews/basic-effects-performance-20261017.md.
